trace.cop: a streak of Copenhagen — some questions you would simply rather not

trace.pw: a stubborn dose of Pilot Wave — you kept receipts
trace.rqm: notes of Relational QM — it depended who was asking

nearmiss.mw|pw: Same bet — the wave is real. The split: they added a particle to point at; you added everything else.
nearmiss.qb|rqm: You both think facts need a witness. The split is the journal question: they say any meeting counts — mushrooms included; you say a witness is something that *bets*.
nearmiss.cop|qb: You both refuse to narrate the unobserved. They closed the question for everyone; you kept it open, first-person.
nearmiss.grw|pw: You both want a mechanism you can point at. Theirs was always there; yours goes off at random — but yours is the one the experiments can catch.
nearmiss.cop|rqm: You both gave up the view from nowhere. They declared the in-between off-limits; you filled it with everyone's.
